messages:
Lee (oncall): heads up, getting paged by the incident bot — sudden 5xx spike on /v2/generate from eu-prod clusters. hitting the paging threshold repeatedly. 
IncidentBot: ALERT: http_5xx_rate_v2 fired (count=78 in 5m) — paging eng-oncall. link: https://grafana.redwood/example/d/alerts/http_5xx_rate_v2
Lee (oncall): i'm on it. initial check: deployment history shows a 3:10 UTC rollout to eu-prod; but the spike starts ~3:17 UTC. rolling back would be disruptive.
Alex Morris: can you paste the error pattern? are these 502/504s or 500s?
Lee (oncall): mostly 502 with some 500. logs show repeated upstream timeout from model-runtime on a subset of pods. excerpt: ```2025-06-17T03:18:12Z ERROR route=/v2/generate upstream_timeout pod=runtime-3b4f```.
Mike SRE: that's the runtime kvcache eviction pattern — seen before when memory pressure + long contexts. any recent batch config changes?
Sara Dev: we didn't change batching. but we did push a quantization variant yesterday to canary; shouldn't affect runtime memory.
Tanya Support: customer-impact note: we have 2 active enterprise customers in eu-prod sending high-concurrency requests. i flagged them in support and asked for request samples.
Lee (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) quiet the noisy alert so it stops paging while we triage (temp squelch 30m) 2) add a short-term routing fallback to a compatible model variant with lower mem (if capacity exists) 3) annotate runbook with customer-impact and handoff notes.
Alex Morris: agree. for quieting i'm going to lower alert sensitivity and add a conditional mute if errors are > threshold but latency still ok. proposed Prom rule patch: ```- alert: http_5xx_rate_v2  expr: sum(rate(http_responses_total{route="/v2/generate",code=~"5.."}[5m])) by (cluster) > 0.03  for: 1m  labels: severity:critical  annotations: runbook: "https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/oncall-http-5xx"```
Alex Morris: new change: add a suppress_if annotation that checks request_success_rate > 0.7 to avoid paging during short blips.
Mike SRE: instead of changing the rule long-term, do a temporary alertmute: `curl -X POST https://ops-api/alertmute -d '{"alert":"http_5xx_rate_v2","duration":"30m","by":"alex"}'` — that will stop pages and still keep the metric in dashboards.
Lee (oncall): doing the mute now. also creating a dashboard annotation for the incident so postmortem groups can find it: https://grafana.redwood/annotations/2035012345
IncidentBot: ACTION: alertmute applied for http_5xx_rate_v2 by Alex Morris for 30m.
Nora PM: estimate customer impact in plain language pls — are requests failing end-to-end or just delayed? need wording for affected customers email.
Tanya Support: from support samples: most requests returned 502 almost immediately, so failing end-to-end. impact concentrated on eu-prod and a single route.
Sara Dev: temporary fallback: route 10% of traffic to quantized-model-v1 variant (less mem) — config snippet to add to router: ```routes:
  - match: /v2/generate
    weight: 90
    model: model-main
  - match: /v2/generate
    weight: 10
    model: model-quant-v1
``` apply with `routectl apply -f fallback.yaml`
Alex Morris: i'm standing up the fallback now. if successful, we should see the 5xx rate drop on the panel within a minute.
Lee (oncall): fallback deployed, monitoring panels.
Mike SRE: seeing a reduction in 502s on runtime-3 nodes. still some errors but trending down.
Lee (oncall): good. next: runbook changes — we need to: 1) update the alert's annotations with a link to the new dashboard panel 2) add an ownership note: SRE owns kv-cache eviction triage; runtime owns model fallback decisions 3) add post-incident checklist item to validate routing fallback thresholds.
Alex Morris: i'll open a PR on the runbook page: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/oncall-http-5xx, section "fallbacks & quieting". i will tag @Mike SRE for ownership.
Nora PM: timeline note for customers: affected window 03:17–03:35 UTC. we should draft a short message: "We experienced 5xx errors on /v2/generate in eu-prod between 03:17–03:35 UTC; we implemented a routing fallback and reduced error rates; if you saw failures, please reach out."
Tanya Support: filing the customer advisory draft now and linking to this thread. will include the grafana annotation and ticket ids.
Lee (oncall): i'm handing off to Alex at 03:30 UTC. adding handoff note in the runbook and tagging oncall rotation: `@oncall-eu`. leave the mute in place until Alex decides.
Alex Morris: thanks — i'll take over. action items for follow-up (assign to me): - PR for runbook updates - update alert rule with suppress_if condition (postmortem) - verify fallback rollback plan if it causes regressions - include cost impact estimate for fallback in the postmortem
Mike SRE: i'll own the metric dashboards: create a panel that breaks 5xx by route+pod and add an explainer note. putting link in runbook.
Lee (oncall): final note: marked incident as "partial customer impact", created incident ticket INC-20350. will kick off postmortem run after stabilization. :white_check_mark:
IncidentBot: Incident INC-20350 created. assignees: Lee (oncall), Alex Morris, Mike SRE.
Alex Morris: thanks team. I'll follow up with the PR and a short runbook patch. leaving the rest to the postmortem. :thumbsup:
